actions.action: Push a finger 3-4 cm into the soil when the plant droops to check moisture
If the soil is still wet while drooping, slide the plant out and inspect for mushy, smelly roots
Ease the plant out of its pot to check whether it is root-bound
Repot one size up into a pot with drainage holes using a soil/perlite or bark mix, loosening circling roots and watering thoroughly
Water when the top 2-3 cm is dry, until water runs out the bottom
If water runs straight through, set the pot in a bowl of water for 20-30 minutes
Move the plant right at the window for maximum light
Set up an LED grow light for 10-12 hours a day during gloomy stretches

reason: The answer correctly identifies thirst but blames it mainly on being root-bound rather than shallow watering, and it leads with repotting, leaving the thorough soak and bowl-soak fix as secondary advice that isn't harmful.
